name: Libya
note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. IDs are TL:<subject>:<measure>:<vintage> and stable across builds: a changed value under the same ID is an upstream revision (recorded in the ledger at /ledger); a new observed year is a new claim. A null or absent figure mints no claim — absence is never zero. Scheme: https://terralore.co/integrity

claims.title: Phoenicians found Leptis Magna
claims.summary: Phoenician colonists establish Leptis Magna, which with Oea (Tripoli) and Sabratha forms the 'three cities' that give Tripolitania its name.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-650bce-phoenicians-found-leptis-magna, claim TL:LBY:event:650bce:phoenicians-found-leptis-magna, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Greeks found Cyrene
claims.summary: Settlers from Thera, led by Battus, found Cyrene in eastern Libya; it becomes the chief city of the Cyrenaican Pentapolis and a renowned centre of Greek culture.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-631bce-greeks-found-cyrene, claim TL:LBY:event:631bce:greeks-found-cyrene, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Cyrenaica passes to Rome
claims.summary: On the death of Ptolemy Apion, Cyrenaica is bequeathed to Rome; Tripolitania likewise comes under Roman authority, opening centuries of prosperity.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-96bce-cyrenaica-passes-to-rome, claim TL:LBY:event:96bce:cyrenaica-passes-to-rome, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Leptis Magna's golden age under Septimius Severus
claims.summary: The emperor Septimius Severus, born at Leptis Magna, lavishes monuments on his home city, making it one of the foremost ports of Roman Africa.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-193-leptis-magna-s-golden-age-under-septimius, claim TL:LBY:event:193:leptis-magna-s-golden-age-under-septimius, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Garamantes flourish in the Fezzan
claims.summary: From their capital at Garama, the Garamantes sustain a desert kingdom through foggara irrigation and command of trans-Saharan trade.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-100-garamantes-flourish-in-the-fezzan, claim TL:LBY:event:100:garamantes-flourish-in-the-fezzan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Arab conquest of Cyrenaica
claims.summary: Arab forces under Amr ibn al-As take Cyrenaica and advance into Tripolitania, beginning Libya's transformation into a Muslim, Arabic-speaking land.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-642-arab-conquest-of-cyrenaica, claim TL:LBY:event:642:arab-conquest-of-cyrenaica, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Arab expeditions reach the Fezzan
claims.summary: Campaigns associated with Uqba ibn Nafi extend Arab-Muslim authority into the Saharan Fezzan, ending the autonomy of the Garamantes' heartland.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-666-arab-expeditions-reach-the-fezzan, claim TL:LBY:event:666:arab-expeditions-reach-the-fezzan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Banu Hilal migration
claims.summary: The westward migration of Arab Bedouin tribes such as the Banu Hilal accelerates the Arabisation of Libya's interior.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1050-banu-hilal-migration, claim TL:LBY:event:1050:banu-hilal-migration, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ottomans capture Tripoli
claims.summary: Ottoman admirals Sinan Pasha and Turgut Reis take Tripoli, establishing the Regency of Tripoli within the Ottoman Empire.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1551-ottomans-capture-tripoli, claim TL:LBY:event:1551:ottomans-capture-tripoli, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Karamanli dynasty seizes power
claims.summary: Ahmed Karamanli founds a hereditary dynasty that rules Tripoli in semi-independence for 124 years under nominal Ottoman suzerainty.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1711-karamanli-dynasty-seizes-power, claim TL:LBY:event:1711:karamanli-dynasty-seizes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: First Barbary War with the United States
claims.summary: Yusuf Karamanli's tribute demands provoke war with the United States; the US Navy blockades Tripoli until a treaty ends the conflict in 1805.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1801-first-barbary-war-with-the-united-states, claim TL:LBY:event:1801:first-barbary-war-with-the-united-states, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ottomans restore direct rule
claims.summary: Sultan Mahmud II ends the Karamanli dynasty and reimposes direct Ottoman administration over Tripolitania.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1835-ottomans-restore-direct-rule, claim TL:LBY:event:1835:ottomans-restore-direct-rule, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding of the Senussi order
claims.summary: Muhammad ibn Ali al-Senussi founds the Sanusi religious order, which from the 1840s becomes the leading power in Cyrenaica and the eastern Sahara.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1837-founding-of-the-senussi-order, claim TL:LBY:event:1837:founding-of-the-senussi-order, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Italo-Turkish War and the invasion of Libya
claims.summary: Italy attacks Tripoli on 3 October 1911 and seizes the Ottoman provinces; the 1912 Treaty of Lausanne cedes the territory to Italy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1911-italo-turkish-war-and-the-invasion-of-libya, claim TL:LBY:event:1911:italo-turkish-war-and-the-invasion-of-libya, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Pacification of Libya
claims.summary: Italian forces wage a war of 'pacification', crushing resistance and deporting Cyrenaica's population into concentration camps where tens of thousands die.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1923-pacification-of-libya, claim TL:LBY:event:1923:pacification-of-libya, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Execution of Omar al-Mukhtar
claims.summary: The resistance leader Omar al-Mukhtar, the 'Lion of the Desert', is captured and publicly hanged at Soluch, breaking organised resistance in Cyrenaica.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1931-execution-of-omar-al-mukhtar, claim TL:LBY:event:1931:execution-of-omar-al-mukhtar, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Creation of Italian Libya
claims.summary: Governor Italo Balbo merges Tripolitania and Cyrenaica into a single colony, Italian Libya, reviving the classical name.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1934-creation-of-italian-libya, claim TL:LBY:event:1934:creation-of-italian-libya, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: North African desert campaigns
claims.summary: The Second World War's desert war sweeps across Libya; by 1943 Allied forces expel the Axis, ending Italian rule and beginning Anglo-French administration.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1940-north-african-desert-campaigns, claim TL:LBY:event:1940:north-african-desert-campaigns, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence of the United Kingdom of Libya
claims.summary: Libya is proclaimed an independent federal monarchy under King Idris—the first state created through the United Nations.

sources.label: The Kingdom of Libya is Established

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1951-independence-of-the-united-kingdom-of-libya, claim TL:LBY:event:1951:independence-of-the-united-kingdom-of-libya, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Commercial oil discovered
claims.summary: The discovery of oil in commercial quantities at the Zelten field transforms Libya's prospects; exports begin in 1961.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1959-commercial-oil-discovered, claim TL:LBY:event:1959:commercial-oil-discovered, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Abolition of the federal system
claims.summary: A constitutional reform replaces Libya's three-province federation with a unitary kingdom.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1963-abolition-of-the-federal-system, claim TL:LBY:event:1963:abolition-of-the-federal-system, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Gaddafi's coup overthrows the monarchy
claims.summary: The Free Officers under Muammar Gaddafi depose King Idris in a near-bloodless coup and proclaim a republic, beginning 42 years of Gaddafi's rule.

sources.label: Qaddafi leads coup in Libya, September 1, 1969

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1969-gaddafi-s-coup-overthrows-the-monarchy, claim TL:LBY:event:1969:gaddafi-s-coup-overthrows-the-monarchy, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Proclamation of the Jamahiriya
claims.summary: Gaddafi declares the 'state of the masses' (Jamahiriya), his idiosyncratic political system set out in the Green Book.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1977-proclamation-of-the-jamahiriya, claim TL:LBY:event:1977:proclamation-of-the-jamahiriya, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: US bombing of Tripoli and Benghazi
claims.summary: In Operation El Dorado Canyon, US aircraft strike Libyan targets in retaliation for a Berlin disco bombing, deepening Libya's confrontation with the West.

sources.label: U.S. bombs terrorist and military targets in Libya

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-1986-us-bombing-of-tripoli-and-benghazi, claim TL:LBY:event:1986:us-bombing-of-tripoli-and-benghazi, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Uprising, NATO intervention and Gaddafi's fall
claims.summary: An uprising from February 2011 and a NATO air campaign from 19 March topple Gaddafi, who is captured and killed at Sirte on 20 October 2011.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-2011-uprising-nato-intervention-and-gaddafi-s-fall, claim TL:LBY:event:2011:uprising-nato-intervention-and-gaddafi-s-fall, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Division and civil war
claims.summary: Disputed elections split Libya between rival governments in Tripoli and the east; Haftar's 2019–2020 assault on Tripoli fails, and a 2021 unity government cannot reunite the country.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Libya: From Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the first state born of the United Nations.", terralore.co/country/LBY/chronicle#ev-2014-division-and-civil-war, claim TL:LBY:event:2014:division-and-civil-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
